author.bulkAuthoring: Actual completion-helper model calls, model alias default; resolved backend model identifier is not exposed by the helper. No fabricated resolved identity.
author.nativeInputPolicy: Canonical English plus only glossaries/en.json, glossaries/fr.json and editorial-policy.json. No other locale Native catalog/glossary was used. Canonical English source-role evidence and English high-risk selection were used for author self-review.

outputs.selfReferentialReportHash: Exact report file hash is recorded in the private delivery-manifest.json beside both output hashes.

method.authorship: 454 actual successful batch results directly authored all 44,549 messages. Requests contain full English schemas, typed parameter values and every exact semantic membership, grouped without semantic loss by field/context/classification/provenance with owner colon tries. Model outputs include actual batch self-review. No dictionary substitution or English-fallback path was used.
method.durability: Each successful batch immediately wrote every authored message indexed by exact source SHA with actual request/result paths, call ID, author self-review and Source13 digest. Raw requests/results/failures retained locally. Pre-correction successful authored records retained in pre-self-review.
method.authorSelfReview: 16 actual further bilingual author-review batch results re-reviewed 661 source schemas, including every canonical high-risk selector, every override schema, all identified provider-publication and SSH-session source-role candidates, and every data-error candidate. Original data errors and actual corrective requests/results are retained.
method.membershipOverrides: 268 exact canonical binding overrides preserve physical sender/recipient action where shared English exchange prose differs from actual operationKind; no source models, actors or values changed. All target owner/field/context tuples matched actual Source13 bindings.
method.identityPolicy: Protected-only identities use existing compiler policy. Only exactly structural templates without explanatory letters outside placeholders receive strong-SHA structural justifications. Explanatory French/English cognates were expressed using natural informative French alternatives, not fabricated editorial approvals.
method.frenchProseSafety: File: source prose was translated as French ordinary prose, not classified as a URI. Existing unsafe-content rules were read and preserved unchanged.
method.aliases: Nine existing topic/lesson stable IDs have eleven hand-authored additive French discovery phrases. Canonical English/identifier discovery is unchanged.

dataOnlyChecks.scope: Author-only deterministic data checks, not resource compilation/build/permanent tests/formatter/lint/browser/AT.
checks: Exact compressed authoritative input SHA256 comparisons
All 44,549 final schema indices and source SHAs resolved from durable records
All 362,328 actual memberships supplied in authoring requests
Exact source placeholder name/count equality for every default and every effective override branch
Exact one/many/other categories only for actual English plural objects; source strings remain strings
No empty branch or malformed brace
Existing unsafe-content expression checked equivalently without weakening validation
No literal em/en dash in Native authored prose
Every override owner/field/context resolved to exact canonical keys
Stable alias canonical IDs exist in English source owners
dataOnlyChecks.scopeLimitation: These checks establish data contracts only; they do not prove full linguistic correctness. Stubs/fallback absence also reflects actual authoring method and author self-review, not an independent semantic proof.

sourceRoleEvidenceUsed: dnssec-signing-cases.js:399 provider publication, not receipt/cached-key verification
